0.note: Exhale, not a word: a faint hot point swells and fades with his voice. The first light in the dark.

1.note: Letters sag on the held note: the baseline bows, letters droop like eyelids. Weight starts here.

2.note: He doesn't want to quit, so QUIT is drawn then crossed by one hot line and refused: it stays on screen, unfinished.

3.note: Held + rising: letters thin from solid to contour lines to nothing, left to right, exactly over the held note. Then come back in as a ghost (he doesn't want to).

4.note: First kick-like hit (18.0). Everything on screen halts mid-motion: dust, grain, the hot point. Freeze lasts the held STOP (~0.6 s).

5.note: The frozen frame becomes a clock face drawn in light; the second hand ticks once and the room starts again.

6.note: Verse world opens: the cover's concrete room from below, empty, the ceiling drawn as a contour plane that lowers a little on each kick.

7.note: Lands on a kick. The ceiling slab pushes PRESSURE flat (squash), letters bulge sideways.

8.note: SAME x3 across lines 6-8 as stamped copies; BLESSED repeats in many voices (people telling him), each copy fainter, out of sync.

9.note: Tries to lie down: REST tips to horizontal and stretches long, then is pulled back up by the beat. Can't rest.

10.note: EVERYBODY stays a caption; PIECE breaks into shards that are pulled off-frame in different directions.

11.note: Repeat 2 of the 'everybody' motif: the clock from 'minute' returns and is torn into wedges; more pieces than last time.

12.note: Hero of verse 1. Stone-filled letters (#c4b6a2) drop and land on the kick, the frame jolts down. First appearance of the WEIGHT block that returns in bridge and outro.

13.note: Held (1.6 s). MINE is carved into the weight block by the hot point while the note holds, small, almost lost.

14.note: A glass display case: envy = people looking in. Glass letters with fingerprints, refraction of the room.

15.note: Name carved into a stone plaque, monumental. Tall condensed headline style.

16.note: A line graph drawn by the hot point climbs. (No money word here, so no red.)

17.note: Held 3 s. The graph line stretches thin over the held note and snaps at the end; the two halves drift apart.

18.note: GOT list part 1. Certificate on paper; edges burn to ash slowly (embers in stone, not orange).

19.note: Achievements as plaques carved into the concrete wall of the room. The wall becomes the trophy wall.

20.note: QUIET won't go quiet: letters vibrate, scanline static on every kick.

21.note: Ink smoke pours out of DARKNESS and fills the trophy wall; 'call' rings faintly as a ripple.

22.note: He is NOT looking for an ending: ENDING appears as a ghost outline and is passed by; the camera doesn't stop on it.

23.note: Held 1.2 s, last word before the chorus. BREAK cracks open down the middle and the gap widens with his volume; through the crack: stars. We fall up into the chorus.

24.note: Director call: never make DIE an effect. It stays a small grey caption, held steady. The hero of the couplet is DRIFT.

25.note: Signature effect. Letters unhook from the baseline and float apart, slow spin, no gravity. 1st time: they only loosen a few pixels.

26.note: Held 0.8 s. 'Float' lifts the line, STARS: each letter is a cluster of points that ignite; the brightness follows his voice.

27.note: FORGET is drawn then the hot point runs backward and unwrites it.

28.note: NO-list 1/3. A calendar grid drawn in light; NO wipes it out (the hot point runs backwards).

29.note: NO-list 2/3. The ECHO crowd of BLESSED copies from verse 1 is erased in one sweep.

30.note: NO-list 3/3. Many overlapping VOICES (echo stack) collapse into one clean line on 'head'.

31.note: Held (2 s on 'this' + 'world'). The 3D contour globe from the old video's toolkit, drawn by the hot point, turning slowly.

32.note: Held 1.1 s high note. The letters B-I-T lift off the globe and float up for exactly the held note.

33.note: Held 3.3 s. Caption only. During the hold, everything else slows to almost still (respect the line).

34.note: Held ~3.5 s. Chorus 1 ending: the letters drift fully apart for the length of the note, following his volume; when the note fades they're stars.

35.note: Verse 2 world: night road. Road lines drawn by the hot point rush toward camera; DESTINATION streaks past unreadable (there is none).

36.note: Radio LOW: a soft waveform ripples through the word, small amplitude.

37.note: Held 1.2 s. NOISE as static/scanline type chasing the car; motif returns in the final chorus ('underneath the noise').

38.note: Static doesn't leave: it sticks to the windshield and drips.

39.note: Held 1.8 s. GREAT in big confident headline; when the note ends it peels like a sticker, showing grey behind.

40.note: Stone letters, quick weight drop (the weight motif, brief).

41.note: 'Everybody' repeat 3: the word EVERYBODY multiplies on the beat (1, 2, 4, 16, 64), the Morph grid.

42.note: The EVERYBODY field slides apart to both edges; APART is left alone in the centre gap. Reprises 'disconnected'.

43.note: GOT list part 2. Ghost-smoke letters that trail.

44.note: Message bubbles echo out and get no answer: the copies shrink into the dark.

45.note: Held 1.3 s on 'miss'. The emotional core. Handwritten, carved slowly by the hot point, no shake, no beat-cuts. Stone accent.

46.note: A voicemail waveform drawn in light, playing; the father line becomes the waveform. Slow.

47.note: Dreams keep him moving: the road comes back, now forward-lit.

48.note: Scars carved deep, then the grooves fill with light (kintsugi in stone/white).

49.note: Kick. The weight block appears, and this time it's held up.

50.note: Held 2.6 s, after the beat drops out. NOTHING empties letter by letter over the note to bare contour lines.

51.note: 'Not forever', held ~3.5 s, almost no beat. FOREVER stretches toward the horizon, then is cut short at the end of the note.

52.note: Held 2 s. The whole frame breathes: scale and glow follow his volume exactly. Then the chorus.

54.note: Repeat: letters drift farther than chorus 1, and the copies left behind from chorus 1 are still floating.

55.note: Twice the stars of chorus 1 (repeats multiply).

57.note: Now erases the verse-2 world (road, crowd).

59.note: More voices than chorus 1, same collapse.

60.note: Globe again, seen from farther away.

61.note: Held 1.3 s arc. B-I-T float higher than last time.

63.note: Held ~1.5 s with vibrato; the drift letters wobble with the vibrato. Hand-off: they settle into the bridge's night sky.

64.note: Weight motif repeat 2: the word CARRYING bears the stone block on its letters, bowing under it. Bridge world: half-time, quieter, nearly monochrome.

65.note: 'Things nobody else can see': the load turns to clear glass; only refraction shows it's there.

67.note: 'Everything everybody needs': the many hands from verse 1 reach in, more of them.

68.note: Kick. A crack runs through FIXING, and nobody repairs it. It's allowed to stay.

69.note: PEACE floats loose and level, the calmest move in the song.

70.note: Held 2.5 s. The sky goes from grey to deep night under ONE NIGHT, a single star ignites per syllable.

71.note: The globe again, and it stops turning: 'doesn't ask'. 'me' held 0.8 s.

72.note: Breakdown: NO-list part 2, five erasures, each faster. Phone drawn in light, rings in ripples, NO erases it.

73.note: Notification badges multiply on the beat (grey, not red: red is for money only) and are wiped.

74.note: The verse-1 ceiling slab from 'pressure' comes back, and NO lifts it off.

76.note: The GREAT mask from verse 2 peels and is gone.

77.note: Everything is erased. An almost empty frame, one hot point. SILENCE is the smallest type in the song.

78.note: The hot point breathes with his voice and grows into the final chorus.

80.note: Held ~1.4 s, beat drops away. Repeat 3: the camera itself drifts, not only the letters.

81.note: The smoke of 'darkness' reaches up and falls short of him.

82.note: 'reach': the past's letters stretch toward him and can't close the gap.

83.note: The melisma on 'hear myself again' (~2.3 s). One clean ripple per note, following his pitch; the clearest moment of the song.

84.note: Beat back. The noise motif returns, small and BELOW him, at the bottom of the frame.

86.note: Kick. STRONGER is stone, builds bigger on each beat.

87.note: Held 3 s. 'But tonight': the brightness pulls back to night, stars, slow.

89.note: Outro: TOMORROW x3 rendered like a sunrise line on the horizon. FIGHTING hits out.

90.note: Held 2 s. BUILDING assembles from drawn lines into a 3D structure (the old video's tower).

91.note: Weight motif repeat 3, final evolution: KEEP stands up under the same stone block from verse 1 and lifts it by choice.

93.note: The last DRIFT: the letters drift until they're indistinguishable from the stars; near-silence 238–249 s (just a breath at 242); the beat returns at 249 s and a single hot point redraws the RUDO wordmark + title card over the instrumental tail.
